text:
tess: Huge news — Queenie is promoted to Senior ML Engineer! :tada: :trophy:
omar: Yesss!!! So deserved. can we get a cake? :cake:
queenie: omg thank you everyone ❤️ honestly stunned. excited to keep building with y’all
raina: congrats!!! would love to bring something savory. taco tray?
kai: I can do cookies + gf option. what day works for a 15-min desk-side cheer?
jo: Thu lunchtime works for me. also +1 on cookies.
tess: Thursday at 12:15? short shout and cake in kitchen island.
people-ops-bot: FYI — team swag tier unlocked for Queenie (applies to senior role). I’ll DM details.
omar: dietary notes: can we get a dairy-free cake option? queenie is allergic to cashews iirc
queenie: minor nit — i’m actually allergic to cashews and can't do almond flour. dairy-free works great. thanks for checking!
kai: noted. i’ll bring vanilla gf cookies (nutfree) and ask bakery for dairy-free cake option.
raina: i’ll bring savory skewers (veggie + chicken).
jo: i can make a small playlist — party vibes? :musical_note:
tess: love it. can someone post a card in the #people-ops channel for signatures?
omar: @people-ops-bot, can we get a physical card?
people-ops-bot: Card request sent to People Ops. Please sign the doc: https://redwood.in/sigs/queenie (link)
calendar-bot: Event created: "Queenie — Senior Promo Mini-Cheer" Thu 12:15-12:30 in Kitchen Island. Invites sent to channel.
jo: who wants to grab the candles? :candle:
omar: I can. also bringing confetti poppers (small, office-safe) :confetti_ball:
queenie: stop you’re all too kind. i’ll bring mini cupcakes just in case?
tess: perfect. last check — anyone needs pickup help from bakery?
kai: I can pick up at 11:45 if someone preorders and sends the receipt.
omar: I’ll place the order and DM receipt to kai.
raina: congrats again, queenie. so proud of you :) :raised_hands:
queenie: thanks team, really means a lot. see you Thursday!
marc (reaction): :tada: (added by marc)
omar (reaction): :heart: (added by omar)
